node.title: Petal realizable extras inject into residue kernel
node.statement: In the L1 coset-chart full-petal residue bridge, every exact realizable full-petal extra determines a squarefree locator point lying in the residue-line kernel, and this assignment is injective.
node.attack_surface: Lemma 8 full-petal rank certificate from the coset-chart bridge
node.falsifier: two distinct realizable full-petal extras with the same locator point, or a realizable extra whose locator does not lie in the residue-line kernel
